locator: ch. 3, para. 5: Ad solam enim catholicam Ecclesiam ea pertinent omnia
interpretation: Everything divinely arranged 'ad evidentem fidei christianae credibilitatem' belongs to the Catholic Church alone. Read as an exclusivity claim about the motives of credibility. It bears on stage 6 (Christ's Church is the Catholic Church) but is not that statement: stage 6 says every visible society with authority that Jesus founded is the Catholic Church, while this text says the signs of credibility belong only to the Catholic Church.
